rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-4: ONE knob -> pretrain_epochs 3 -> 6 (2x warm-start budget). KEEP lr=1e-4 (the iter-3 winner). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): iter-1 lr1e-3/n_iter400 SSIM 0.4785; iter-2 n_iter1200 0.4293 (more per-scan steps HURT -> per-image overfit, n_iter ruled out); iter-3 lr1e-3->1e-4 0.4880 (+0.01, the overfit-anchor lever). The lr-anchor gain was SMALL and exactly as iter-3 predicted: 'at lr=1e-4 the per-image fit barely moves off warm-start' -- so the per-scan recon is now PINNED to the warm-start init. iter-3 named this iter's lever verbatim: 'if SSIM is still flat at ~0.47 the warm-start init itself is the floor and iter-4 should toggle warm_start / raise pretrain_epochs.' SSIM rose only 0.4785->0.4880, i.e. essentially the warm-start floor. FAILURE MODE now = warm-start init is the operating point and is under-trained at 3 epochs; with lr anchored at 1e-4 the per-scan fit cannot escape a poor init, so the init quality is the ceiling. unet_c is NOT the lever (campaign-state: mayo c16->c32 flat 0.9508; solver design doc warns capacity is not the lever for this loss) and n_iter is RULED OUT (iter-2 regressed). So the remaining lr=1e-4 lever is the INIT: raise pretrain_epochs 3->6 to give the amortized GT-free N2I warm-start pre-pass twice the budget to settle on a better U-Net init, which the lr=1e-4 per-scan fit then preserves and slightly refines. HYPOTHESIS: a better-converged warm-start init lifts SSIM above the 0.4880 iter-3 plateau toward the LD-FBP baseline (still structurally FBP-bounded on 128-view, so expect approach-to-baseline / small headroom, not a large jump); if SSIM stays flat at ~0.49 the warm-start pre-pass is already saturated at 3ep and iter-5 should probe warm_start sensitivity (toggle off, or seed). WALL: warm 6x200=1200 + per-image 6x600=3600 = 4800 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 400 s (iter-3 was 340s at 4200 steps), well under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1200 guard, and the 1800 s sbatch wall. All other knobs IDENTICAL to iter-3 (train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16).
